query: Apple September 2026 event date iPhone 18 Pro

results.content:
Apple is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max at its September 2026 event, with reports pointing to upgrades in processing power, cameras and display design. Apple has not yet officially announced the event date or confirmed the specifications of the upcoming iPhones.

According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple is preparing to launch its premium iPhone models during the traditional September Window. [...] The iPhone 18 Pro is expected to be powered by Apple's next-generation A20 Pro chip, which reports say could be manufactured using TSMC'S 2- nanometre process. Apple is also rumoured to introduce a smaller Dynamic Island, potentially by moving some Face ID components
results.title: iPhone 18 Pro Launch: What Apple’s September 2026 Event Could Bring

results.content:
The iPhone 18 Pro Max should carry the same core upgrades as its smaller sibling, scaled up to fit the larger 6.9-inch form factor. Expect the same shrunken Dynamic Island, the same A20 Pro chip on TSMC’s 2nm node running iOS 27, and the same C2 modem with expanded satellite internet as the iPhone 18 Pro. [...] The 6.3-inch display size is expected to carry over unchanged from the iPhone 17 Pro. Under its shiny aluminum and glass exterior, the iPhone 18 Pro could sport the new A20 Pro chip, which could be Apple’s first chip to embrace the highly efficient 2nm fabrication technology (after Samsung).

Since the keynote is happening a day later than in last year’s timetable, I believe, it’s possible that the reviews could land a day later as well, which would be Thursday, September 17 this year.

However, my best guess is that we’ll see the first verdicts on the Wednesday, September 16, 2026.

As for the time, last year this was the same time of day as pre-orders, that is, 5 a.m. Pacific, 8 a.m. Eastern and 1 p.m. U.K.
